cohort: 40 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at a tertiary care hospital in Bihar, India
finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy was 0.10%, with uterine atony, uterine rupture (of both scarred and unscarred uterus), and placenta previa being the most common indications.
mod_finding: Incidence of subtotal hysterectomy was higher after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal deliveries.
